svg.title: Draw it: the map, the profile, and the floor
svg.desc: A large empty dashed frame for the student to draw in, with three instructions underneath: draw the PCA map with three cluster shapes and the percentage written on both axes, draw one cluster's profile row with three numbers each paired with the overall value beside it, and draw the two by two noise floor table with all four numbers in it.
svg.text: Draw it: the map, the profile, and the floor
1. the map: three cluster SHAPES, not just colours, and both axes (36.2%, 19.2%)
2. one cluster's three defending numbers, each with the overall value, in real units
3. the two-by-two noise floor: silhouette and seed ARI, real vs noise, four numbers
